properties.description: An unmodelled subtree is reported and a modelled file is not; ONE OPAQUE ARTIFACT LEGITIMATELY CLAIMS THE MASS BENEATH IT (900 vendored files under a single registered directory report zero unclaimed — the trap a file-count ratio would fall into, since it would score correct coarse modelling as 1-of-901 and call it failure); a shared name prefix does not claim across a directory boundary; exclusions come back NAMED with the rule that excluded them and their mass does not inflate the silence; regions rank by mass so the biggest silence sorts first; a registered location the sweep never mentioned is named; and an empty sweep claims nothing rather than reading as full coverage (crates/reflow2-core/tests/coverage.rs, 7 cases)
properties.name: An unmodelled subtree is reported, and one opaque artifact may claim the mass beneath it
